How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NCERT Assistant Editor Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NCERT Assistant Editor recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NCERT Assistant Editor position is 04 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Assistant Editor post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognized university and a Post Graduate Diploma in Book Publishing, Mass Communication, or Journalism, with editing as a subject.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Assistant Editor post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Assistant Editor position in the NCERT recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Editor role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Assistant Editor post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 56,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 45 years. However, retired government persons can apply up to the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any experience required for the Assistant Editor position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates need to have five years of experience in editing, producing, planning, and supervising publications, particularly school textbooks, monographs, and reports.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the NCERT Assistant Editor job?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to send your bio-data and required documents to the specified email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q8. What is the nature of the job?
faq.answer: The Assistant Editor position at NCERT is on a temporary basis, specifically for the project 'E-Magazine Sapnon Ki Udaan'.

faq.question: Q9. What documents are required at the time of the interview?
faq.answer: At the time of the interview, candidates must bring original certificates/testimonials and their self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Assistant Editor role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve shortlisting of candidates based on their applications, followed by an interview.
